answer: trellis is the one ledger pinning key, route and first verdict; each raven, one clone, must collide there. The kth raven enters only with a quorum spanning k separate branches and posts a glacier of k^2 frozen bond sealed to that key, nontransferable; one branch backs one raven, and matching outputs slash every branch plus the glacier. n raven need n disjoint branch-sets and about n^3/3 frozen capital, raised serially as live count grows. It fails if trellis merges aliases, branches collude or are captured, or a glacier moves.
